text.casual: Hollow Vale lead 1-0 at Arden Park. Arden have had the ball more but not the chances.
text.tactical: 1-0 Hollow Vale after 30 minutes: Arden 55% possession, 0.31 xG against 0.52.
text.commentator: Hollow Vale have not won here since 2022, and they lead for the first time in that run.

trivia.text: Hollow Vale's last away win at Arden Park came in the 2022-23 season.

text.casual: Half time: Hollow Vale 1-0 up through a quick break. Arden's best chance was saved in the 23rd minute.
text.tactical: Half time 0-1. Arden 0.36 xG from 6 shots, Hollow Vale 0.64 from 11; Arden's only big chance (0.36 xG) was saved.
text.commentator: One-nil to the visitors at the break, and Arden have not come back from a half-time deficit at home this season.

trivia.text: Arden have won 2 of their last 10 home matches after trailing at half time.

text.casual: Tremblay is the one keeping Arden in this. He keeps getting there first.
text.tactical: Rhys Tremblay: 14 defensive actions by the hour, six more than any teammate, three of them inside his own box.
text.commentator: Tremblay joined from Stonebrook in 2025 and already looks like the leader of this back line.

trivia.text: Tremblay made 113 league appearances for Stonebrook Harriers before joining Arden.

text.casual: Two-nil Hollow Vale. Arden need something quickly or this is gone.
text.tactical: 0-2 at 59:42. Arden 0.42 xG from 8 shots, Hollow Vale 1.02 from 20.
text.commentator: Two-nil down at home with half an hour left. Arden have never recovered from that in the five seasons on record.

trivia.text: Arden have lost all 6 home league matches in which they trailed by two goals since 2021-22.

text.casual: Level at 2-2 with 13 minutes left. Arden have all the momentum now.
text.tactical: 2-2 at 77:12. Arden 1.39 xG from 12 shots, Hollow Vale 1.30 from 27.
text.commentator: Two-two, and Arden's record scorer Finn Castellan is two goals short of 30 for the club.

trivia.text: Finn Castellan has 28 league goals for Arden, 2 short of 30.

text.casual: Arden have turned this around in five minutes. Two goals, and the crowd is right behind them.
text.tactical: Two Arden goals in 4 minutes 8 seconds from 0.97 xG; momentum 78 to 22 over the last five minutes.
text.commentator: Two goals in four minutes. The last time Arden scored twice that quickly at home was against Kestrel Bay in 2024.

trivia.text: Arden's quickest two-goal burst at home in the archive is three minutes, against Kestrel Bay in 2024-25.

text.casual: Full time: Arden 3-2 Hollow Vale. Two down with 18 minutes left, and a substitute wins it in stoppage time.
text.tactical: Full time 3-2. Arden 3 goals from 1.95 xG, Hollow Vale 2 from 1.48; all three Arden goals came after the 72nd minute.
text.commentator: From two down to a stoppage-time winner. Arden had never come back from 0-2 at home in the five seasons on record.

trivia.text: No Arden home win from two goals down appears in the 2021-22 to 2025-26 results.
